purpose: Characterize changing-environment failure modes before developing a new adaptive policy
change_window_zero_based: 60 except silent_fast at 6; constant cases split at 60 for reporting only
primary_endpoint: After-change localized repeat identity with IoU >= .25; occurrences and admission labels retained from before the change
secondary_endpoints: same-state current-source-deletion attention and repeat identity
uncertainty: Equal-seed means, paired seed bootstrap 10000 draws using RNG seed 731; descriptive intervals without multiplicity adjustment
no_tuning: Existing method settings retained. No adaptation policy or threshold is selected using these evaluation outcomes.
